raw_intent: Board decision: resolve the seal-commit path first. Provide a loop-sanctioned way for an already Checker-PASSED Trail to persist its seal without bypassing the existing git-write boundary or rewriting prior Trail history.
true_intent: Fix the discovered implementation gap: after a Checker PASS, seal.ps1 writes disposition.json but nothing can commit it (commit.ps1 refuses a trail that already has a disposition). Extend seal.ps1 to make one scoped, append-only, local commit of the seal, never a push and never a modification of a prior committed frame. Implementation-gap only.
done_means: seal.ps1, after writing disposition.json, makes one local commit scoped to the trail; stages only files under trails/NNNN-name; refuses a modification of a tracked trail file (Append-Only, LAW-010); refuses an absolute path (EC-0001); refuses staged changes outside the trail; never pushes
proven able to fail on a fixture repo (real output): normal seal commits disposition.json exit 0; modified prior frame refused; absolute path refused; staged change outside the trail refused
no company.json change, no law/policy change, no seat activation, no push, no install, no spend; Append-Only and Checker independence preserved
tools/build.ps1 stays deterministic and dotnet build and test still pass
